Market today: Jobs data crushed expectations, suggesting the economy is still hot. This is bad for your margin-heavy, tech-focused book, as it means higher rates for longer.

Your holdings: CRWD (25.5%) and SPY (0.57%) are the only ones in the green, but both are marked SELL. SMCI (-34.67%), SOXL (-80.07%), and MU (-63.22%) are deep in the red and need serious attention. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: The market's reaction to the strong jobs report and any hints from Jim Cramer.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your deeply underwater leveraged positions and protecting your capital.
plays: Consider trimming CRWD (25.5%) to reduce exposure, especially with SPY and QQQ marked SELL.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
